# Kalaa

> Creative social media marketing agency. Kalaa creates social strategies,
> content, and campaigns that turn attention into real business growth.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kalaa.io/): What Kalaa does, and who it is for.
- [Contact](https://kalaa.io/contact): How to reach Kalaa. Email, WhatsApp and
  the office address in Surat, Gujarat.
- [Privacy policy](https://kalaa.io/privacy-policy): What personal data Kalaa
  collects, how it is used, how long it is kept, and your rights over it.

## Notes

- Contact: hey@kalaa.io for anything else, privacy@kalaa.io for anything about
  personal data.
- Keep this file in step with `src/routes.ts`. A page added there without a line
  here is invisible to the answer engines that read this file rather than
  crawling the site.
